Interviewer: Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 87 pp.

Today is September 28th, 2011. This is the Smithsonian oral history interview with NEA Jazz Master Ramsey Lewis, pianist, composer, arranger, media personality, and entrepreneur, conducted in his home in Chicago. Good afternoon.
Good afternoon. How are you today?
I’m fine. If we could just start by you stating your full name, your date of birth, and your place of birth.
Ramsey Emmanuel Lewis, Jr. Chicago, Illinois. May 27, 1935.
